fields.label: Question
fields.value: What does a buying agent do?

fields.label: Content
fields.value: I represent you, the buyer. I help define your brief, find and assess suitable homes, negotiate a purchase and support you through to completion. The selling agent represents the seller; I am there to look after your interests.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Can you help if I don’t know the area?

fields.label: Content
fields.value: Yes. We can start with what matters to you rather than a postcode. I help you focus your search across Hertfordshire, west Essex and South Cambridgeshire, considering how each location could work for your life.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Do you only search for off-market homes?

fields.label: Content
fields.value: No. I consider homes on the open market alongside private and pre-market opportunities. The important thing is how well a property fits your brief. Off-market availability varies, so I cannot promise a particular home will be available.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Will I work with you directly?

fields.label: Content
fields.value: Yes. My business is personal: you work directly with me throughout the search. I take on a small number of clients and avoid searches that would put my clients in direct competition with each other.

fields.label: Content
fields.value: Call or email me and tell me a little about your plans. We can discuss where you are looking, your timing and the support you need. I will explain my service and agree the fee arrangement with you before any work begins.

fields.label: Search description
fields.value: What off-market property means, why sellers choose a private sale and how to prepare for a focused search beyond the property portals.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Finding a home beyond the property portals.

fields.label: Content
fields.value: Waiting for a listing can leave you seeing only part of the picture. Here is how I approach a search that includes private and pre-market opportunities.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Start with what matters to you

fields.label: Content
fields.value: Before looking for a property, get clear about the life you want it to support. Think about location, space, budget and timing, as well as the things you could compromise on. A focused brief makes it easier to recognise a suitable opportunity.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Understand why a home may be sold privately

fields.label: Content
fields.value: Not every seller wants a public launch. Some value privacy; others want to explore demand before committing to a wider marketing campaign. An agent may also introduce a home to a few suitable buyers before it appears online.

fields.label: Content
fields.value: These situations are different from one another. Understanding the seller’s intentions helps you decide how to approach the opportunity.

fields.label: Content
fields.value: Off-market searches depend on people as much as property listings. I stay in touch with local agents and contacts, explain my clients’ requirements and explore relevant introductions. Where appropriate, I also approach homeowners directly.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Be clear about your buying position

fields.label: Content
fields.value: A seller will want to understand your timing and whether you are in a position to proceed. Having a realistic budget and a clear picture of your own sale, if you have one, helps make those conversations productive.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Assess the home on its merits

fields.label: Content
fields.value: A private sale is not automatically a bargain. Look at how the property meets your needs, its condition, the surrounding area and the asking price. The usual care and professional checks still matter.

fields.label: Content
fields.value: I help my clients weigh up the opportunity, negotiate and keep the purchase progressing. My search includes both openly advertised and privately offered homes: the aim is to find the right fit for you.

fields.value: Off-market homes in Hertfordshire | Emma Siddons

fields.label: Search description
fields.value: Looking beyond the property portals? I help buyers explore off-market and pre-market homes in Hertfordshire through local knowledge and personal connections.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Your next home may not be on a property portal.

fields.label: Content
fields.value: Some homes change hands quietly, without ever being advertised publicly. I help you explore those possibilities alongside the open market.

fields.label: Content
fields.value: An off-market home is offered privately, rather than advertised to everyone. A seller may value discretion, want to explore interest before launching, or prefer a quieter sale.

fields.label: Content
fields.value: A pre-market opportunity is a little different: the property may be due to launch publicly, but an agent is already speaking to suitable buyers.

fields.label: Content
fields.value: I draw on relationships with local agents, word of mouth and direct approaches to homeowners. A clear brief helps me explain what you are looking for and recognise an opportunity that could fit.

fields.label: Content
fields.value: Hertfordshire is my main focus. I also help buyers searching in west Essex and South Cambridgeshire.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: The right fit matters more than the label

fields.label: Content
fields.value: Off-market does not automatically mean better value, and it does not guarantee an easier purchase. I look carefully at each home, its price and its suitability for you, whether it is being sold privately or openly.

fields.label: Content
fields.value: Private opportunities change with the market and your brief. I cannot promise a particular property will be available, but I can help you search more widely and make an informed decision.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: A little more about buying privately

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Can I see a list of off-market properties?

fields.label: Content
fields.value: Private sellers often do not want their homes advertised. I discuss relevant opportunities with clients individually, based on their search brief and the seller’s wishes.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Do I need to be ready to buy?

fields.label: Content
fields.value: It helps to be clear about your budget, timing and buying position. We can discuss these at the start so I can approach opportunities with a realistic understanding of your circumstances.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Will you also look at homes on the open market?

fields.label: Content
fields.value: Yes. My search is led by what suits you. I consider publicly marketed homes as well as private and pre-market opportunities.

fields.value: Let’s talk about your next home

fields.label: Content
fields.value: Tell me what you are looking for, and I’ll explain how I can help.
